name: account-inflight-unlock-not-installed

graded_by.test: owed: Provider starts vault unlock on account login A and pauses before install. A separate administrator login disables A account or sets its password, or another login of A changes own password. The acted-on account is the owner of the challenged login, not the administrator. Resume unlock: no install after login end. Exercise both orderings: install before purge is removed, otherwise install refused. All ends and purges complete before successful account response. Trusted devices, terminal sessions and stored credentials remain.
